channel.title: Pier & Point · 700 Indiana St
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for 700 Indiana St (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · 700 Indiana St: The 700 Indiana page now gives its distance to the nearest tracked Pier 70 feature as about 360 meters (it said 470) and cites the Board of Supervisors' Motion M24-089, approved 9-1 on September 24, 2024; an earlier 8-2 vote in the minutes was the failed motion to table.

item.title: Added · 700 Indiana St: New nearby-project record for 700 Indiana St, a proposed lab/office building for MBC BioLabs next to Pier 70, approved by the Planning Commission in June 2024; the Board of Supervisors rejected a neighborhood CEQA appeal in September 2024.

item.title: Milestone · 700 Indiana St: SF Board of Supervisors approves Motion No. M24-089 (File No. 240778) 9-1, affirming the Planning Department's CEQA general plan evaluation exemption and rejecting a neighborhood appeal (Appeal No. 24-040); Supervisor Walton (District 10) cast the dissenting vote and Supervisor Peskin was excused. The Board's minutes of September 24, 2024 also record an earlier 8-2 vote on the same file: Supervisor Walton's motion to table M24-089 failed, 2 ayes (Ronen, Walton) to 8 noes. (Sep 24, 2024)
